content: Mikrotik split DNS: no true wildcard support, only regexp entries which must escape dots (.*\.example\.com$), are lowercase-only, slower than plain entries, and match ANY subdomain including ones you meant to be public — regexp entries shadow real DNS. allow-remote-requests=yes required for LAN clients but exposes port 53 to WAN unless firewalled (open resolver risk). Hairpin NAT needed if clients resolve public IP for local services; split DNS avoids it but only for clients using the Mikrotik resolver (DoH on browsers bypasses LAN DNS). Sources: Mikrotik docs + forum threads.
